resources.string: Read and write files in its workspaces on this phone
Run programs in the Helper\'s Linux system, with network access
Start MCP servers in the Helper and use their tools
Ask Android to install an app it built
Use boards plugged into the phone\'s USB port, each once Android has asked you
Read what is on screen and list the apps. Your messages, photos and accounts go to this app and its AI model when they are on screen
Act on this phone as you
Open apps, tap, swipe and type in any app, as if you had done it. Apps that hold money or passwords ask you first

Run any command a computer plugged in for USB debugging could: install and remove apps, change settings, read logs. A command can get around the Helper\'s questions, so allow this only if you trust the app and its model completely
